meta_description: Keyless North East is Newcastle's trusted locksmith. Emergency callouts, lock repairs, and access solutions available 24/7. Call now for fast help.
hero_subhead: Locked out or lost your keys? Keyless North East arrives fast, any time of day or night, to get you back inside.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to security upgrades, we handle every lock problem quickly and professionally.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home or car at 2am? We arrive in under 30 minutes and get you back inside without damage to your doors or locks.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken locks, stuck mechanisms, and worn cylinders fixed or replaced the same day. We fit quality locks that last and keep you secure.

services.title: Lock Installation
services.desc: New doors, new home, new security standards? We install modern locks, deadbolts, and multi-point systems tailored to your property.

services.title: Upvc Door & Window Repairs
services.desc: UPVC locks jam or break regularly. We repair mechanisms and replace faulty handles and locks without the cost of a full door replacement.

services.title: Key Cutting & Duplication
services.desc: Spare keys cut on the spot while you wait. We can cut standard keys, euro profile keys, and security keys from your original or lock.

services.title: Security Upgrades
services.desc: Improve your home or business security with anti-snap cylinders, high-security locks, and expert advice on weak points.

about_pullquote: We treat every lockout like it's our own home — fast, friendly, and no faffing about.
about_para_1: Keyless North East has been Newcastle's trusted emergency locksmith for over 12 years. We started because too many people were being left stranded by slow, expensive locksmiths. Today we handle over 1,200 emergency callouts a year — lockouts, broken locks, UPVC repairs, and security installations. We're available 24/7, and we arrive fast because we know being locked out is stressful.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on speed, honesty, and fair pricing. We never charge call-out fees, we carry spare parts on every van, and we always give you a quote before we start work. Hundreds of Newcastle homes and businesses call us because they know we'll get them out of trouble without breaking the bank or damaging their doors.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Keyless North East

reviews.text: Got locked out of the house at 11pm on a Sunday. Called Keyless and they were here in 25 minutes. Really friendly bloke, sorted the lock straight away, and charged a fair price. Best locksmith in Newcastle, wouldn't use anyone else.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: My UPVC door lock was stuck solid, couldn't open it. Thought I'd need a whole new door. Keyless came out same day, fixed the mechanism in half an hour. Saved me hundreds. Brilliant service, highly recommend.
reviews.author: Emma K.

reviews.text: Called for an emergency lockout and they literally arrived in 20 minutes. No damage to the door, polite, professional, and the price was exactly what they quoted. Can't fault them. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Michael J.
